needed.evidence: The left side of the road is an open, paved area used for parking and loading, with no defined or continuous footway for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, paved footway on the left side, separated from the parking area by a kerb or bollards.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road, in front of the shop, is an open paved area with no defined footway, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, paved footway on the right side, in front of the shop, to provide a safe path for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: A marked zebra crossing is visible, but it is not a purpose-built facility like a raised platform or signalised crossing.
needed.suggestion: Install a raised pedestrian crossing at the marked zebra crossing to improve safety and visibility.
